faqs.q: Which of these comedy movies are good to watch with family?
faqs.a: Home Alone, Shrek and Mrs. Doubtfire are the most family-friendly picks on this list, with humour that works for both children and adults. The Hangover, Superbad, Bridesmaids and Deadpool contain strong language and adult jokes, so they are better suited to grown-up viewers.

faqs.q: What are some classic Hindi comedy movies like these?
faqs.a: If you enjoy these films, Hindi comedy classics often recommended include Andaz Apna Apna, Hera Pheri, Chupke Chupke, Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro and Munna Bhai MBBS. Like the Hollywood picks here, they rely on mistaken identities, absurd situations and memorable dialogue rather than just slapstick.

faqs.q: Where can I watch these comedy movies online in India?
faqs.a: It changes often, because films move between streaming services as licensing deals start and end. Search the film's name on the major OTT platforms or a streaming availability guide to see where it is currently available to stream, rent or buy, and avoid pirated sites.

faqs.q: Do comedy movies really help reduce stress?
faqs.a: They can help in the short term. A good laugh helps many people relax, lifts their mood and eases tension, and watching a comedy with friends or family adds the benefit of shared time together, though it is not a substitute for proper help with ongoing stress.
